function scriptzoneCallback(zone)
    local objects = zone.getObjects()

    for i, obj in ipairs(objects) do
        if
        obj.getGUID() ~= "e7ca6e"
                and obj.getGUID() ~= "6012bf"
                and obj.getGUID() ~= "4ee1f2"
                and obj.getGUID() ~= "948ce5"
                and obj.getGUID() ~= "28865a"
            then
            obj.destruct()
        end
    end
    zone.destruct()
end

function loadModels(objectClicked, clickerColor, altClickUsed)
    local scriptzoneParams = {
        position = {x=1.170000, y=10.000000, z=12.500000},
        scale = {x=158.190000, y=19.000000, z=102.820000},
        type = 'ScriptingTrigger',
        callback_function = scriptzoneCallback,
        callback_owner = self,
    }

    -- Only clear if enabled
    local autoClearEnabled = false
    if autoClearEnabled then
        spawnObject(scriptzoneParams)
    end

    Wait.time(function()
        -- Get spawner position
        local spawnerPos = self.getPosition()
        local spawnHeight = 2
        local spacing = 6  -- Space between ships horizontally

        -- Calculate starting X position to center the line of ships
        local totalWidth = (10 - 1) * spacing
        local startX = spawnerPos.x - (totalWidth / 2)

        local spawnStartTime = os.clock()
        local shipsSpawned = 0
        
        for i = 1, 10 do
            local params = shipParamList[i]
            
            -- Calculate spawn position (line them up horizontally)
            local spawnPos = {
                x = startX + ((i - 1) * spacing),
                y = spawnerPos.y + spawnHeight,
                z = spawnerPos.z
            }

            -- Parse the base ship JSON
            local baseShipJSON = objectJSONs[1]
            local shipObj = JSON.decode(baseShipJSON)
            
            -- Inject spawner parameters into LuaScriptState
            shipObj.LuaScriptState = JSON.encode({
                spawnerParams = params,
                useSpawnerParams = true
            })
            
            -- Convert back to JSON string
            local modifiedShipJSON = JSON.encode(shipObj)

            -- Spawn with injected parameters
            spawnObjectJSON({
                json = modifiedShipJSON,
                position = spawnPos,
                sound = false,
                callback_function = function(spawnedObj)
                    shipsSpawned = shipsSpawned + 1
                    local spawnTime = os.clock() - spawnStartTime
                    print(string.format("Ship %d/%d (%s) spawned - Total time: %.3fs", 
                        shipsSpawned, 10, params.name, spawnTime))
                    
                    if shipsSpawned == 10 then
                        broadcastToAll(string.format("✓ All 10 variant ships spawned in %.2fs", spawnTime), {0, 1, 0})
                    end
                end
            })
        end
    end, autoClearEnabled and 0.5 or 0)
end

function clearModels(objectClicked, clickerColor, altClickUsed)
    local scriptzoneParams = {
        position = {x=1.170000, y=10.000000, z=12.500000},
        scale = {x=158.190000, y=19.000000, z=102.820000},
        type = 'ScriptingTrigger',
        callback_function = scriptzoneCallback,
        callback_owner = self,
    }
    spawnObject(scriptzoneParams)
    broadcastToAll("Area cleared", {1, 0.5, 0})
end
